obligations.text: An explicit resource Deploy value takes precedence over the lifecycle default, unless a named deployment parameter exists on that class: then only parameter value 1 enables deployment, even when the resource says true.

obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/packaging-deployed-code.g5.md metadata module.deployed (iter3 resources.rs deploy, iter4 repairs4.rs deploy) (control lifecycle-defaults-swapped rejected)

obligations.text: The class parameter override applies only to an existing class with that parameter.
obligations.cases: class resource with the parameter vs nonexistent class vs non-class resource

obligations.text: The lifecycle default comes from DEPLOYBYDEFAULT and is used only when the resource has no Deploy attribute.
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/packaging-deployed-code.g5.md metadata module.deployed (iter3 resources.rs deploy, iter4 repairs4.rs deploy)

obligations.text: A custom lifecycle inherits its parent's default unless it sets its own.
obligations.cases: subclass of DeployedModule without vs with its own DEPLOYBYDEFAULT
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/packaging-deployed-code.g5.md metadata module.deployed (iter3 resources.rs deploy, iter4 repairs4.rs deploy)
obligations.gap: Lifecycle::Subclass(b) takes the inherited default as an input, so parameter inheritance is not modeled. Contrast: a Lifecycle/DeployedModule subclass that does not override DEPLOYBYDEFAULT deploys an undeclared resource.

obligations.text: Built-in compiled-only deployment applies to classes and MAC/INT routines; include files and other types keep their source form unless their own processor handles deployment.
obligations.observation: whether the shipped item is compiled-only
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/packaging-deployed-code.g5.md metadata module.deployed (iter3 resources.rs deploy, iter4 repairs4.rs deploy)
obligations.gap: load_project takes deployable_type as a Boolean input, so type classification (ResourceProcessor/Default/Document.cls) is not modeled. Contrast: Deploy="true" on an .inc ships its source while a .cls ships compiled-only.

obligations.text: IPM picks the package built for the current IRIS version and platform.
obligations.cases: deployed package with matching vs other platform/version tags
obligations.gap: iteration15 oras.rs selects by platform suffix within a bounded literal ORAS domain, with the current platform as an input. The IRIS-version component of the build and other repository types are not modeled.

obligations.text: IPM installs deployed code into each resource's mapped database.
obligations.cases: resource mapped to a different code database vs the namespace default
obligations.gap: No formal rule. Contrast: a package mapped to another code database receives the deployed classes there.

parent.entailment: The parent owns the deploy decision and defaults (#1-#8). The child owns project-load eligibility and markers and does not entail any parent obligation. No composition is credited.

obligations.text: makedeployed <module> turns eligible resources selected by the deployment rules into compiled-only code.
obligations.observation: source presence and compiled code after makedeployed
obligations.basis: new:iteration-68 (project map binds Lifecycle/Base.cls::%MakeDeployed to resources.rs deploy/selected)
obligations.gap: The deploy decision is modeled, but the conversion effect is not (source removed, compiled code kept, Deployed flag set, unselected resources untouched). Contrast: after makedeployed a selected class has no source but runs, while an unselected one keeps its source.
No formal rule for phase recursion over dependencies in makedeployed. Contrast: a dependency with Deploy="true" changes only with -recurse.

obligations.text: A deployed resource loads from the module's Studio project only when its type is deployable or its name is a path, the project file exists and the resource is neither generated nor preloaded; otherwise the ordinary source path remains in use.
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/packaging-deployed-code.g5.md metadata module.deployed.project-load (iter3 resources.rs) (controls generated-uses-project, preload-uses-project, all-types-use-project, missing-project-still-used rejected)

obligations.text: IPM sets the object's Deployed flag before attempting its save; if save fails the database row can remain false while the object says true, and the installer is not called.
obligations.observation: object flag, stored flag, installer call

obligations.text: After save succeeds, a corrupt-project install error can leave the stored flag true; neither flag proves installation.
obligations.cases: install error vs success after a successful save

obligations.text: A process-local marker is set only after successful project installation; other resources using that path then skip the installer; failure leaves no marker, so a later attempt may retry.
obligations.cases: install success vs failure; second resource with marker set

obligations.text: A fresh duplicate resource reference can cause the earlier save to fail, while reusing its stored identity does not. Provider writes before failure are not assumed atomic.
obligations.cases: new duplicate object vs reused identity
obligations.observation: save allowed, stored flag, installer call

obligations.text: Packaging's project check removes missing project items and can return success after doing so; check success alone does not establish that every requested item remains.
obligations.cases: project with a missing item vs all present
